# Mike Kostenko – Java Software Engineer

> Java Software Engineer (backend and desktop) in Porto, Portugal, with 8 years in fintech at Devexperts (4+ in QA, then development). Oracle Certified Professional (OCP), Java SE 21. Looking for senior backend Java roles, remote within the EU. Contact: contact@singledev.eu
